instrument_symbol_no_isin_key.name: instrument_symbol_no_isin_key
instrument_symbol_no_isin_key.where: "instrument"."kind" <> 'CRYPTO' AND "instrument"."isin" IS NULL AND "instrument"."symbol" IS NOT NULL

transaction_buy_sell_shape.name: transaction_buy_sell_shape
transaction_buy_sell_shape.value:
"transaction"."kind" NOT IN ('BUY', 'SELL') OR (
        "transaction"."instrument_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_currency" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_amount" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."source_dividend_id" IS NULL
      )

transaction_deposit_withdrawal_shape.name: transaction_deposit_withdrawal_shape
transaction_deposit_withdrawal_shape.value:
"transaction"."kind" NOT IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL') OR (
        "transaction"."txn_currency" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."instrument_id" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."quantity" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."unit_price" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_currency" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_amount" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."source_dividend_id" IS NULL
      )

transaction_dividend_shape.name: transaction_dividend_shape
transaction_dividend_shape.value:
"transaction"."kind" <> 'DIVIDEND' OR (
        "transaction"."instrument_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."quantity" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."unit_price" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_currency" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_amount" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."source_dividend_id" IS NULL
      )

transaction_drip_shape.name: transaction_drip_shape
transaction_drip_shape.value:
"transaction"."kind" <> 'DRIP' OR (
        "transaction"."instrument_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."quantity" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."source_dividend_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_currency" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_amount" IS NULL
      )

transaction_currency_exchange_shape.name: transaction_currency_exchange_shape
transaction_currency_exchange_shape.value:
"transaction"."kind" <> 'CURRENCY_EXCHANGE' OR (
        "transaction"."txn_currency" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_currency" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."target_amount" IS NOT NULL
        AND "transaction"."instrument_id" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."quantity" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."unit_price" IS NULL
        AND "transaction"."source_dividend_id" IS NULL
      )

transaction_currency_xor_settlement_inst.name: transaction_currency_xor_settlement_instrument
transaction_currency_xor_settlement_inst.value: ("transaction"."txn_currency" IS NOT NULL) <> ("transaction"."txn_settlement_instrument_id" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_fee_cash_account_pairing.name: transaction_fee_cash_account_pairing
transaction_fee_cash_account_pairing.value: ("transaction"."fee_cash_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("transaction"."fee_currency" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_wht_cash_account_pairing.name: transaction_wht_cash_account_pairing
transaction_wht_cash_account_pairing.value: ("transaction"."wht_cash_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("transaction"."withholding_currency" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_target_cash_account_pairing.name: transaction_target_cash_account_pairing
transaction_target_cash_account_pairing.value: ("transaction"."target_cash_account_id" IS NULL) OR ("transaction"."target_currency" IS NOT NULL)

transaction_cash_degenerate_equals_gross.name: transaction_cash_degenerate_equals_gross
transaction_cash_degenerate_equals_gross.value: "transaction"."cash_currency" IS NULL OR "transaction"."cash_currency" IS DISTINCT FROM "transaction"."txn_currency" OR "transaction"."cash_amount" = "transaction"."gross_amount"

transaction_settled_principal_has_no_cas.name: transaction_settled_principal_has_no_cash_leg
transaction_settled_principal_has_no_cas.value: "transaction"."txn_settlement_instrument_id" IS NULL OR ("transaction"."cash_currency" IS NULL AND "transaction"."cash_amount" IS NULL)

transaction_fiat_principal_has_cash_acco.name: transaction_fiat_principal_has_cash_account
transaction_fiat_principal_has_cash_acco.value: "transaction"."txn_currency" IS NULL OR "transaction"."cash_account_id" IS NOT NULL

transaction_target_has_cash_account.name: transaction_target_has_cash_account
transaction_target_has_cash_account.value: "transaction"."target_currency" IS NULL OR "transaction"."target_cash_account_id" IS NOT NULL

transaction_fee_has_cash_account.name: transaction_fee_has_cash_account
transaction_fee_has_cash_account.value: "transaction"."fee_currency" IS NULL OR "transaction"."fee_cash_account_id" IS NOT NULL

transaction_wht_has_cash_account.name: transaction_wht_has_cash_account
transaction_wht_has_cash_account.value: "transaction"."withholding_currency" IS NULL OR "transaction"."wht_cash_account_id" IS NOT NULL
